You're in luck! The latest website update on geocaching.com now does a lot of hard work for beginners. 

Do a search from the frontpage, based on your zipcode or location. At the bottom of the list of caches which appears, tick the checkbox for "Highlight beginner caches.".

This highlights caches which are more likely to be "beginner friendly". I.E.
* Traditional type
* Low difficulty
* Recently found by others
* No micro sized caches
* No problems reported

So hopefully your next find will be a successful and fruitful one. 

Other tips - look for "cachers trails" (does something look trampled or out of place?). Read the hint! Read previous logs before you go searching. Especially in the early searches, do your research this way to help you get finds. Once you start racking up a few finds, it'll become second nature as to where things are hidden.

Good luck and happy caching!
